players.product: data-center chillers, BASX custom air handlers & liquid-cooling packages (Redmond / Memphis)

quarterly_data.signal: The June 2026 investor presentation's table of BASX production by location lists dedicated BASX square footage of ~250,000 at Longview, TX (optimizing production), 787,000 at Memphis, TN (ramping up production) and 419,000 at Redmond, OR (increasing throughput; maximizing productivity). AAON states 1M+ sq. ft. of BASX production capacity has been added since 2024, up nearly 6x, and that the larger footprint equates to at least 2 billion in revenue capacity, with upside potential; the deck also states demand outweighs HVAC market supply.
quarterly_data.figure: dedicated BASX sq ft: Longview, TX ~250,000; Memphis, TN 787,000; Redmond, OR 419,000; 1M+ sq. ft. BASX production capacity added since 2024 (up nearly 6x); at least 2 billion in revenue capacity

quarterly_data.signal: The June 2026 presentation says data center TAM is shifting to liquid cooling: to date a vast majority of the TAM for the thermal management equipment BASX provides to data centers is cloud compute data centers cooled by air-side equipment, and by 2028 AAON anticipates the split to be 60% liquid and 40% air-cooled.
quarterly_data.figure: by 2028 anticipated split 60% liquid / 40% air-cooled (AAON estimate)

quarterly_data.signal: The 2026 outlook shown in the June 2026 presentation: sales growth of 40% to 45%, gross margin of 27% to 28%, SG&A of 14% to 15% of sales and D&A expense of 95 to 100 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 outlook as of the June 2026 presentation: sales growth 40% to 45%, gross margin 27% to 28%, SG&A 14% to 15% of sales
